description: Spider Aqua Eyes (Spider Aqua Eye Booster) is a Korean injectable booster formulated specifically for the delicate periorbital area. It pairs a spider-silk-derived polypeptide with salmon polynucleotide (PN) and non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid to combine regeneration with intensive hydration around the eyes. It is positioned as a targeted under-eye skin-quality treatment rather than a volumising filler.
howItWorks: The salmon-derived polynucleotide (PN) component supports tissue repair and fibroblast activity, helping the skin regenerate collagen and extracellular-matrix components over successive weeks, while the non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid draws water into the dermis for immediate hydration and improved elasticity. The spider-silk polypeptide and supporting peptides are intended to reinforce the fine skin of the periorbital region.
composition: Spider-silk polypeptide, polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA, non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid, Tetrapeptide-44 and urea; supplied in a 2 mL syringe.
usageNotes: Delivered by fine microinjection or cannula into the periorbital area, typically as a short course of sessions spaced roughly 3-4 weeks apart per practitioner protocol. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Includes spider-silk polypeptide and supporting peptides
benefits: Single SKU targeting a high-demand periorbital indication
Combination regeneration-plus-hydration positioning for clinic menus
Prefilled format streamlines chairside preparation
Supports course-based, repeat-visit treatment plans
Differentiated eye-specific offering versus generic HA boosters
indications: Periorbital fine lines and crow's feet
Loss of elasticity around the eyes
Skin texture and radiance in the eye area

description: Rejuran Skinbooster is PharmaResearch's polynucleotide (PN) injectable line, one of the most established salmon-DNA skinboosters in the Korean aesthetics market. Rather than adding volume, it is designed to improve overall skin quality by supporting the skin's own repair processes. The range spans several targeted formulations built around highly purified salmon polynucleotides.
howItWorks: The active polynucleotides are DNA fragments derived from salmon, processed using PharmaResearch's DNA-fragment optimising technology. Once injected into the dermis they support tissue repair and boost fibroblast activity, helping regenerate collagen and other extracellular-matrix components lost with ageing, which in turn improves elasticity, texture and hydration.
composition: Highly purified polynucleotide (PN) derived from salmon DNA; individual variants add hyaluronic acid and/or lidocaine (see specific product entries).
usageNotes: Administered by dermal microinjection (manual or via injector gun), typically as a course of multiple sessions spaced around 3-4 weeks apart, with periodic maintenance. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Range of targeted formulations (Healer, HB, S, I)
benefits: Strong brand recognition supports enquiry-to-order demand
Portfolio approach lets clinics match variant to indication
Repeat-course protocol drives recurring revenue
Positioned for skin-quality treatment menus
Complements, rather than competes with, HA fillers

description: Rejuran Healer is the flagship product of PharmaResearch's Rejuran polynucleotide range, supplied as a higher-volume syringe of highly purified salmon PN. It is used for overall facial rejuvenation, targeting skin quality, texture and resilience rather than adding volume. It is one of the most widely used salmon-DNA skinboosters internationally.
howItWorks: Polynucleotides extracted from salmon DNA support tissue repair and stimulate fibroblast activity when injected into the dermis, promoting regeneration of collagen and extracellular-matrix components. This improves skin elasticity, texture and hydration progressively over the weeks following treatment.
composition: Highly purified polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA; typically supplied as 2 mL (commonly a 2 x 2 mL pack).
usageNotes: Delivered by multiple micro-injections across the treatment area, usually as a course of 3-4 sessions spaced around 3-4 weeks apart, with maintenance thereafter. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Higher per-syringe volume for full-face work
benefits: Recognised hero product that drives clinic enquiries
Cost-effective volume for full-face treatment
Supports recurring course-and-maintenance protocols
Fits premium skin-quality service tiers
Broadly applicable across adult skin types

description: Rejuran (I/S) refers to the targeted variants of PharmaResearch's Rejuran polynucleotide range: Rejuran I for the delicate under-eye area and Rejuran S for scar-focused treatment. Both are built on the same salmon-derived PN active but tuned in viscosity and concentration for their respective indications. They extend the Rejuran line beyond general facial rejuvenation into region- and concern-specific care.
howItWorks: As with the wider Rejuran range, salmon polynucleotides support tissue repair and fibroblast activity, driving regeneration of collagen and extracellular matrix. Rejuran I uses a lower-viscosity formulation to sit smoothly in thin periorbital skin, while Rejuran S is more concentrated and viscous to support remodelling in scarred or texturally damaged skin.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA; Rejuran I is a lower-viscosity 1 mL formulation, Rejuran S a higher-concentration, more viscous 1 mL formulation.
usageNotes: Injected by fine micro-injection into the target region, typically as a multi-session course spaced around 3-4 weeks apart. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Two targeted variants: I (eye) and S (scar)
benefits: Indication-specific SKUs broaden the Rejuran menu
Under-eye variant addresses a high-demand concern
Scar variant opens acne-scar treatment revenue
Same trusted PN platform as the flagship line
Supports course-based, repeat-visit protocols
indications: Under-eye fine lines and dark-circle-associated skin quality (Rejuran I)

description: Rejuran HB is the hydration-focused member of PharmaResearch's Rejuran range, combining salmon polynucleotide (PN) with non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid and lidocaine in a single 1 mL syringe. It pairs Rejuran's regenerative PN signal with the immediate moisture of HA and a more comfortable injection experience. It is often positioned for patients seeking regeneration plus instant hydration, including first-time skinbooster users.
howItWorks: The polynucleotide component supports tissue repair and fibroblast activity over the following weeks, driving collagen and matrix regeneration, while the non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid draws water into the dermis for immediate hydration and improved elasticity. The included lidocaine reduces discomfort during treatment.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA, non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid, and lidocaine (0.3%); supplied in a 1 mL syringe.
usageNotes: Administered by dermal micro-injection to the face and neck, typically as a multi-session course spaced around 3-4 weeks apart with maintenance thereafter. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: PN plus non-cross-linked HA in one syringe
benefits: Entry-friendly option that eases first-time patients into skinboosters
Two mechanisms (regeneration + hydration) in a single SKU
Lidocaine improves the treatment experience and reviews
Extends the trusted Rejuran brand into hydration positioning
Supports recurring course-based protocols

description: Regenovue Aquashine Plus is a hyaluronic-acid-based skinbooster from the Korean manufacturer NeoGenesis. It uses a minimally/non-cross-linked HA formulation intended to deliver deep dermal hydration with a longer-lasting effect than standard single-session boosters. It is positioned as a skin-quality and glow treatment rather than a volumising filler.
howItWorks: The hyaluronic acid hydrates the dermis by binding water and, by replenishing the skin's moisture reservoir, helps improve elasticity, plumpness and overall texture. The minimally cross-linked structure is designed to extend residence time in the skin and prolong the hydrating effect relative to fully non-cross-linked boosters.
composition: Minimally/non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid at approximately 15 mg/mL in phosphate-buffered saline (pH ~7.0).
usageNotes: Delivered by mesotherapy-style micro-injection or micro-bolus technique across the treatment area, typically as a course of sessions spaced a few weeks apart per practitioner protocol. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Minimally cross-linked HA for extended duration
Focused on hydration and skin glow
benefits: Longer-lasting positioning versus basic HA boosters
Part of an established Korean filler/booster house
Fits glow and hydration service menus
Supports course-based repeat treatments
Complements regenerative (PN) offerings in a catalogue

description: Miracle L is a polycaprolactone (PCL) collagen-stimulating skinbooster from the Korean Miracle range. Unlike hyaluronic-acid boosters, it works as a biostimulator, using PCL microspheres to prompt the skin's own collagen production for progressive lifting and firming. Because it contains no hyaluronic acid, it is positioned as an option for patients with HA sensitivity.
howItWorks: The polycaprolactone acts as a biostimulator: as the PCL is gradually metabolised it stimulates fibroblasts to produce new collagen, progressively firming, lifting and thickening the skin. The effect builds over weeks and is longer-lasting than simple hydration boosters.
composition: Polycaprolactone (PCL) microsphere suspension (cited around 20% PCL); contains no hyaluronic acid.
usageNotes: Injected into the dermis/subdermis by micro-injection or cannula across the face, neck or hands, typically as a course of sessions per practitioner protocol; effects reported to build within about a week and last up to around a year. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Part of the Miracle range by DEXLEVO
benefits: Serves patients with HA sensitivity
Biostimulation differentiates from HA booster menus
Long-lasting results support premium pricing
Applicable to face, neck and hands
Pairs well with HA boosters in combination protocols
indications: Skin laxity and loss of firmness

description: Miracle H is a hybrid skinbooster from the Korean Miracle range that combines polycaprolactone (PCL) with hyaluronic acid. It aims to pair the progressive collagen-stimulating effect of PCL with the immediate hydration of HA in a single product. It is positioned for general rejuvenation and deep moisturising of facial skin.
howItWorks: The polycaprolactone acts as a biostimulator, prompting fibroblasts to generate new collagen for progressive firming and thickening, while the hyaluronic acid provides immediate hydration and improved elasticity. Together they deliver both an instant plumping effect and a longer-term regenerative one.
composition: Polycaprolactone (PCL, cited around 20%) combined with sodium hyaluronate (hyaluronic acid); supplied in 2 mL vials.
usageNotes: Injected into the dermis by micro-injection or cannula on the face, neck or back of the hands, typically as a course of sessions per practitioner protocol; results reported within about a week and lasting up to around a year. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Combines PCL biostimulation with HA hydration
Suited to mature and sun-damaged skin
Part of the Miracle range by DEXLEVO
benefits: Dual-action SKU (hydration + collagen stimulation)
Broad applicability across face, neck and hands
Long-lasting results support repeat business
Differentiated from HA-only booster menus
Complements the HA-free Miracle L in the range

description: Hyaron is a non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid skinbooster from Korean manufacturer DongKook Pharmaceutical. It delivers a low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate into the dermis to create an immediate hydration reservoir and improve skin quality. Originally developed for intra-articular use, it is now widely used as an aesthetic hydrating skinbooster.
howItWorks: The non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid binds many times its own weight in water, hydrating the dermis and helping restore elasticity, plumpness and texture. Because it is non-cross-linked it is readily metabolised, so results are built and maintained through a course of repeated sessions.
composition: Non-cross-linked sodium hyaluronate, 25 mg per 2.5 mL prefilled syringe (approximately 10 mg/mL); supplied with a fine needle.
usageNotes: Delivered by superficial dermal micro-injection or mesotherapy technique to the face, neck or back of the hands; commonly given as a foundational course of 3-4 sessions spaced roughly 2-3 weeks apart. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
benefits: Accessible entry-level hydrating booster for clinic menus
Simple single-ingredient profile eases patient counselling
Course-based protocol supports recurring visits
Applicable across face, neck and hands
Pairs well with regenerative PN or biostimulator products
